_readme: S381 SkyRowan, 2026-10-13. Coastline's re-read (run 38429656959) found 32 of 159: Information Technology A.S. (.../information-technology/information-technology-as/) reached its page only through the link search, and reading each page's program links beneath it added one page (child_pages 1), so either the sitemap names the program pages under another address or the reader's 2,500-link cap stops before a subject page's program links. This read asks the sitemap for three program pages the link search found and loads the subject page that links them. Two loads, no model call.

questions.sitemap_program_pages: Whether the sitemap lists the program pages (information-technology-as, aging-studies-aa, business-as), and at which addresses.
questions.subject_links: How many links the subject page carries, and where its program links sit among them.
